topProcesses.command: python3 import sys sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/BasicSR') sys.path.insert(0, '/tmp/Real-ESRGAN') import setuptools, distutils import numpy as np import cv2, time from PIL import Image import tempfile, os from basicsr.archs.rrdbnet_arch import RRDBNet from realesrgan import RealESRGANer model = RRDBNet(num_in_ch=3, num_out_ch=3, num_feat=64, num_block=23, num_grow_ch=32, scale=4) upsampler = RealESRGANer( scale=4, model_path='/workspace/scratch/models/RealESRGAN_x4plus.pth', model=model, tile=0, tile_pad=10, pre_pad=0, half=False, device='cpu', ) print('Model loaded', flush=True) sys.path.insert(0, 'tools') from keynet_loader import load_keynet data = load_keynet() img = data['obverse'][0] t0 = time.time() sr_img, _ = upsampler.enhance(img, outscale=4) t1 = time.time() print(f'SR: {img.shape} {sr_img.shape} in {t1-t0:.1f}s', flush=True) # Compare edge profiles import keynet_decode as kd from scipy.ndimage import maximum_filter1d for name, image, sr_scale in [('Original', img, 1), ('SR 4x', sr_img, 4)]: gray = cv2.cvtColor(image, cv2.COLOR_RGB2GRAY) if len(image.shape) == 3 else image mask, contours, largest = kd.segment_key(gray) if largest is None: continue vs, bxs, bxe, bbox, mask = kd.find_blade_region(largest, gray.shape[1]) bp = kd.extract_bottom_profile_subpixel(gray, bbox, bxs, bxe) if len(bp) < 10: continue xs = np.array([p[0] for p in bp]) ys = np.array([p[1] for p in bp]) smooth_ys = kd.smooth_1d(ys, 2.0 * sr_scale) env = maximum_filter1d(smooth_ys, size=max(5, int(len(smooth_ys) * 0.15) | 1)) near = smooth_ys > env 2.0 * sr_scale if near.sum() < 3: near = np.ones(len(smooth_ys), dtype=bool) coeffs = np.polyfit(xs[near], smooth_ys[near], 1) baseline = np.polyval(coeffs, xs) residual = baseline smooth_ys blade_span = bxe vs ppi = blade_span / kd.SC1_BLADE_LENGTH incr = kd.SC1_DEPTH_INCREMENT * ppi snr = residual.max() / np.std(residual) if np.std(residual) > 0 else 0 print(f'{name}: {len(bp)}pts span={blade_span:.0f}px ppi={ppi:.1f} incr={incr:.2f}px/step SNR={snr:.2f}', flush=True)
